name: Bakunyuu Tengoku Angel Bitches 2
original_name: 爆乳天国エンジェルビッチーズ2
source:
I’m just a lowly guard angel… or so I thought. Today, while I was standing guard at the gates of Heaven, I was suddenly summoned by Archangel Raphael.

I was wondering why on earth she’d call someone like me, when it turns out the human capital has made a pact with the demon race and is about to fall into the clutches of evil.

So she told me to go to the capital and sort things out. She also told me to go ahead and mete out divine punishment to the humans while I’m at it.

On top of that, she said my senior angel, Milkyne, would be tagging along. With everything laid out for me like that, I can’t very well refuse!

I’m going to go there and rape all the cute girls in the capital to my heart’s content!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01463724.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
我只是一名地位卑微的守门小天使……原本我是这么以为的。今天在天界大门站岗值勤时，我竟突然受到了大天使拉斐尔的亲自传召。

正纳闷她老人家到底为什么会叫上我这种小角色，原来是人间王都竟与魔族暗中缔结了契约，眼看就要彻底沦入邪恶的魔爪之中。

于是她下令派我前往王都摆平事态，还嘱咐我顺便替天行道，好好向堕落的人类降下神罚。

不仅如此，她还安排我的天使前辈米尔琪奴与我同行。把天大的好事全都安排得这么妥妥当当，我哪还有拒绝的道理！

这趟去王都，我一定要把城里的可爱美少女们随心所欲地睡个遍！！
